_readme: Pin a book's cover when the automatic lookup gets it wrong.
Open Library is community-catalogued, so an edition record occasionally has
the wrong image attached (e.g. an unofficial 'summary' book's cover filed
under the real title). An entry here always wins over the lookup.
Key   = the book's exact title as it appears in books.json
Value = an Open Library cover id (number), an image URL, or a local file path
Then review every cover with: node build-books.js --audit
